dedupe_resolutions.notes: The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement. Neither duplicates the other's event or unit.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

Both records arise from the U.S.-hosted G20 meetings on September 1, but they document distinct proposals in separate tracks: light-touch AI governance at the technology meeting and trade barriers responding to Chinese export imbalances at the finance ministerial.

rejected_candidates.title: Twenty-four new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: The feed advanced from 35,996 to 36,020 posts. Trump's Iran statement was used only as primary evidence of his rationale and threat after the underlying U.S. strikes were independently confirmed. The other posts were campaign endorsements, book and corporate-link promotion, repeated film-industry material, energy rhetoric, a routine CDC advisory appointment, or an asserted $5 million Iowa disaster approval for which no FEMA instrument or independent confirmation was located by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Congressional stopgap funding bill
rejected_candidates.reason: The House sent the Senate-passed continuing resolution to Trump, but it was not signed by cutoff. The Record will treat enactment, a veto or another operative development as the lifecycle event rather than present House passage as an appropriation already in force.

rejected_candidates.title: Mifepristone litigation pause
rejected_candidates.reason: Reuters reported during the window that a judge had paused the states' case while FDA reviews the drug, but the order was entered before the checked boundary and preserved the existing procedural status rather than deciding access, safety or the merits. It remains a lifecycle lead for the existing abortion-medication record.

rejected_candidates.title: Prospective Chevron Venezuela expansion
rejected_candidates.reason: The expected investment announcement was attributed to an unnamed U.S. official and was scheduled for the following day. No company instrument, investment amount, signed operational agreement or implemented expansion was public by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Iran bank sanctions and other G20 statements
rejected_candidates.reason: The anticipated Iranian bank designation remained unidentified and unissued. Statements about Japanese monetary policy, unresolved communique language and other diplomatic positions did not create another operative U.S. policy or agreement.

rejected_candidates.title: COSCO intelligence allegations and other anonymous reports
rejected_candidates.reason: Consequential operational claims continued to rest substantially on unnamed officials without adequate independent confirmation or a new public primary record. They remain research leads rather than findings.

rejected_candidates.title: Routine personnel, endorsements, criminal and duplicate coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: A CDC advisory appointment, campaign endorsements, state or private litigation, personnel chatter, promotional posts and duplicate coverage did not establish another material federal action in the window.
